verdict.rationale: Pika's own docs say it can create clips or full videos from user references and can set a style while adding references for multi-shot films. However, none of the evidence explicitly says it extracts the visual style of a reference video or image and applies it to new footage. Motion Transfer copies movement from a reference clip, not its look, and 'restyle' refers to editing an existing visual. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of style transfer from a reference video or image into newly generated footage, any detail on how closely output matches the reference style, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can point at a reference video or image and generate new footage in that style

citations.quote: Create short clips or full videos from your references
Set the style and add references to develop a script, storyboard and film with multiple shots.
Motion Transfer: Add moves from reference videos
